title: Music Player Interface
description: Build a music player with playlist management, playback controls, progress tracking, and shuffle functionality.

steps.title: Create the song data structure
steps.description: Define a song object with `title`, `artist`, `duration` (in seconds), and `url` fields. Create a sample song and log its details.
hints: A song object: { title: 'Song Title', artist: 'Artist Name', duration: 210, url: 'https://...' }
Duration should be in seconds (e.g., 3:30 = 210 seconds)
Use JSON.stringify to log the song object

verification.successMessage: Song data structure is ready with all required fields!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure the song object has title, artist, duration, and url fields with the example data.

steps.title: Create the playlist and current song tracker
steps.description: Define a `playlist` array containing multiple songs and a `currentSongIndex` variable to track which song is playing. Log the current song.
hints: Create a playlist array with 3-4 songs using the song structure
Set currentSongIndex = 0 to start at the first song
Access the current song: playlist[currentSongIndex]

codeTemplate.python:
playlist = [
  {"title": "Bohemian Rhapsody", "artist": "Queen", "duration": 354, "url": "song1.mp3"},
  {"title": "Stairway to Heaven", "artist": "Led Zeppelin", "duration": 482, "url": "song2.mp3"},
  {"title": "Hotel California", "artist": "Eagles", "duration": 391, "url": "song3.mp3"}
]

currentSongIndex = 0

print("Now playing:", playlist[currentSongIndex]["title"])

verification.successMessage: Playlist and current song tracker are set up!
verification.failureMessage: Create a playlist array with at least 3 songs and a currentSongIndex pointing to the first song.

steps.title: Implement play and pause functions
steps.description: Write `playSong` and `pauseSong` functions. `playSong` sets a `isPlaying` flag to `true` and logs the current song. `pauseSong` sets it to `false` and logs a pause message.
hints: Create a let isPlaying = false variable outside the functions
playSong: set isPlaying = true, log 'Playing: <title>'
pauseSong: set isPlaying = false, log 'Paused: <title>'

verification.successMessage: Play and pause functions work correctly!
verification.failureMessage: playSong should log 'Playing: <title>' and set isPlaying to true. pauseSong should log 'Paused: <title>' and set isPlaying to false.

steps.title: Track progress with elapsed and total time
steps.description: Create an `elapsedTime` variable and a `seekTo` function that updates it. Write a `getProgress` function that returns a formatted string like `"1:30 / 3:54"`.
hints: Format seconds as mm:ss: Math.floor(seconds / 60) + ':' + String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, '0')
getProgress: format elapsed + ' / ' + format current song duration
Keep elapsedTime between 0 and the song's duration

verification.successMessage: Progress tracking shows elapsed time against total duration!
verification.failureMessage: seekTo(90) should set elapsed to 90 and getProgress should return '1:30 / 5:54'. Seek to max duration should cap at 354.

steps.title: Implement shuffle using Fisher-Yates algorithm
steps.description: Write a `shufflePlaylist` function that randomly reorders the playlist using the Fisher-Yates (Knuth) shuffle algorithm. Log the reordered titles.
hints: Loop from the last index down to 1
Pick a random index j between 0 and i: Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1))
Swap playlist[i] with playlist[j]

codeTemplate.python:
import random

playlist = [
  {"title": "Song A", "artist": "A1", "duration": 200, "url": "a.mp3"},
  {"title": "Song B", "artist": "A2", "duration": 180, "url": "b.mp3"},
  {"title": "Song C", "artist": "A3", "duration": 220, "url": "c.mp3"},
  {"title": "Song D", "artist": "A4", "duration": 190, "url": "d.mp3"}
]

titles = [s["title"] for s in playlist]

verification.failureMessage: shufflePlaylist should iterate backwards through the array and swap each element with a randomly chosen earlier element.
